readThrough.concerns: Staging matches the P7 anchor: L1-4 para+inf, L5-8 para que with whitelisted stems (funcione, llegue, puedan, tenga, haya), L9-10 mixed at path level. All ten frozen trophies present and recycled in learner turns; recall, speakRequired, chunk concat and cloze concat identities hold in every lesson. Spanish is Spain usage (coger el tren, vale, gasolina, móvil-era register), gender-free throughout (perderse is infinitive; L8 'la niña' is a third party, not the speaker). Fixed: L1 them-turn overstated the physical constraint; L2 'petrol' is British in en-US base; L3 'aprovechar la espera' too formal for friends; L4 'para dejarte tiempo con las invitaciones' stilted; L5-9 connector chips 'aunque' / 'mientras que' pair with the indicative form chips into grammatical sentences (aunque funciona, mientras que llega, mientras que haya sitio reads as a condition), breaking single-correct; L9 'entrar al centro' is LatAm-leaning, Spain says 'entrar en'; L8 term gloss 'Platz ist' is not German; register value 'informal' does not match the architecture's Spanish register pair usted/tú. Form cues never print the answer and identify the third-person subject (el micrófono, Marta, todos, nadie). Pattern examples teach the target form but do not reveal hidden-turn content. L10 timing is coherent as staged: agreement closes at eight, workshop ends at eight, fifteen-minute extension only if the group tidies, so they clean and close at eight-fifteen.

P7 trophies and beats match the draft one to one; no edit. Note 2 ('esta propuesta no introduce tú') predates the architecture decision to introduce tú at B1; the draft follows the architecture (mostly tú for P7). No change to the plan file; owner decision recorded as open issue.
